main.description: Individual Council Lv6+ member's vote in a charter attestation deliberation. ≥3 of these aggregated form a charter-attestation record. Per ADR-2605192230 §6.

requestUri.description: AT URI of the charter-attestation-request being deliberated.

councilMemberDid.description: DID of the voting Lv6+ Council member.

vote.description: This member's individual determination. 'abstain' is permitted (e.g., conflict of interest).

rationale.description: Member's reasoning. Public record. PII-free except for the subject's name/address.

conflictOfInterestDisclosure.description: Optional COI disclosure (recused if material; abstain vote required).

memberSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (requestUri, vote, rationale) digest.
